# Couch: TV Remote

> Couch is a universal TV remote for iPhone. It controls smart TVs and streaming players over your home Wi-Fi: power, d-pad, touchpad, keyboard, volume, channels, app launcher and casting, for as many TVs as you own. Free download with a 7-day free trial of the full remote and casting. Couch Plus is a one-time A$3.99 that unlocks them for good. No ads, no subscription.
